fields.name: Players
fields.evidence: esv::camera::AllArrivedSystem::Update (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xA29E20): for every 4-byte id in the system's list of players that reported arrival (this+0x10, count this+0x1C) it searches the component's int array (pointer +0, size +0xC) and appends missing ids (FUN_180279600). The entity is destroyed when the array's size equals the expected player count. Ids are 4-byte player/peer ids (exact kind not established). Live: always empty.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.evidence: Same function sets *(float*)(component+0x10) = s_ArriveTimeout when the component is created (FUN_180a29210 get-or-add) and subtracts the frame time each update; at <= 0 the entity is destroyed. Live 1.93-2.0.

open_questions: Whether the ids are UserId or net PeerId values.
